title: Marvel Drops First Avengers: Doomsday Trailer as Robert Downey Jr.'s Doctor Doom Takes Center Stage
excerpt: The trailer features Doctor Doom battling Thor, the return of Chris Evans as Captain America, and a massive ensemble cast spanning the MCU, X-Men, and Fantastic Four.
body:
• Marvel released the first full trailer for Avengers: Doomsday on Monday, ahead of the studio's San Diego Comic-Con showcase later this week.
  • Robert Downey Jr. returns to the MCU as Doctor Doom after playing Tony Stark for 11 years, with Chris Evans also back as Captain America.
  • The trailer reveals a multiverse collision story drawing from the Secret Wars comic arc, uniting heroes from the MCU, X-Men, and Fantastic Four franchises.
  • Avengers: Doomsday opens in theaters on December 18, 2026, directed by the Russo brothers.

Marvel Studios on Monday released the first full trailer for Avengers: Doomsday, giving fans their most substantial look yet at Robert Downey Jr.'s transformation from Iron Man to the franchise's next great villain, Doctor Victor von Doom.

The trailer dropped ahead of Marvel's highly anticipated presentation at San Diego Comic-Con on July 25, where the studio is expected to reveal additional footage and details in Hall H.

Doom vs. Thor

The centerpiece of the two-minute trailer is a dramatic confrontation between Doctor Doom and Chris Hemsworth's Thor. In the sequence, Thor hurls Stormbreaker at Doom, who stops the weapon mid-air with a single movement of his hand — establishing Doom as a threat far beyond anything the Avengers have faced before.

"Something's coming, something we may not be able to deter," warns Patrick Stewart's Professor Xavier in a voiceover that signals the scope of the threat.

The trailer opens with Reed Richards (Pedro Pascal) and Sue Storm (Vanessa Kirby) of the Fantastic Four discussing an imminent danger. It then cycles through quick-cut sequences showing the newly assembled Avengers, led by Florence Pugh's Yelena Belova, preparing for battle.

A Multiverse Collision

Marvel Studios president Kevin Feige has previously described the film as being inspired by the Secret Wars comic run, in which parallel universes collide. The trailer makes good on that premise, showing characters from three distinct cinematic universes — the core MCU, the Fantastic Four's parallel reality, and the X-Men's universe — converging for the first time on screen.

Among the glimpses: Shang-Chi (Simu Liu) sparring with Gambit (Channing Tatum), Yelena facing off against Mystique (Rebecca Romijn), and Tom Hiddleston's Loki appearing in his TVA suit. An emotional scene between Scott Lang (Paul Rudd) and his daughter Cassie (Kathryn Newton) offers a quieter counterpoint to the mayhem.

"One day you will forgive me."

— Doctor Doom, in the trailer's closing line

The trailer's final moments bring the biggest reveal: Chris Evans's Steve Rogers — Captain America — returns, alive and apparently fighting fit, much to Thor's visible astonishment. Evans and Downey Jr. both departed the franchise after Avengers: Endgame in 2019, where Tony Stark died and Rogers passed the shield to Sam Wilson.

The Biggest Cast in Marvel History

The confirmed cast reads like a who's-who of superhero cinema. Beyond Downey Jr., Evans, Hemsworth, and Pugh, the film features Anthony Mackie, Sebastian Stan, Letitia Wright, Paul Rudd, Tom Hiddleston, Patrick Stewart, Ian McKellen, Pedro Pascal, Vanessa Kirby, Simu Liu, Channing Tatum, and many more.

The Russo brothers — Anthony and Joe — return to direct after helming Captain America: The Winter Soldier, Civil War, Infinity War, and Endgame. A sequel, Avengers: Secret Wars, is scheduled for December 2027.

India Box Office Implications

Marvel films have massive pull in India, where Avengers: Endgame earned over ₹400 crore and remains the highest-grossing Hollywood release in the country. The addition of a multiverse crossover featuring beloved characters from across Marvel's history is expected to generate enormous anticipation among Indian audiences, particularly with December positioning the film for a holiday-season release.

Avengers: Doomsday opens worldwide on December 18, 2026. The full trailer is now available on Marvel's official YouTube channel.
